title: Research Analyst — Equity Capital Markets
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. About the Role We are building a suite of tokenized equity capital markets products from the ground up, and are looking for a Research Analyst to join a small, high-impact team. This is a 0-to-1 opportunity for a self-starter who wants to help shape products from inception through launch. The analyst will support the full product lifecycle — conducting due diligence on issuers, companies, vendors, and partners; building commercial and economic models; and producing the research, memos, and analysis that underpin key commercial decisions. The role is highly cross-functional, working closely with internal stakeholders in a fast-moving environment where initiative and ownership are essential.
